title: A unified analysis of maximum-norm estimates for a class of HDG methods for parabolic problem in polyhedral domains
summary: This paper studies a general class of semi-discrete hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) methods, including mixed methods, for parabolic problems in nonconvex polygonal and polyhedral domains. By developing local energy error estimates together with energy estimates for a regularized Green's function, we establish a unified framework to prove the maximum-norm stability of both the semigroup defined by the semi-discrete scheme and the corresponding discrete solutions.
